decisions.why: All 14 products crawled from yourkoalaa.com are soft upper-limb prosthetic sockets/sleeves (ALX Starter Bundle, Amy ALX, Grace ALX, Joeyy, Paww-type items), which is squarely 'Prosthetic components' — the company's own site describes them as prosthetics for adults and children with limb differences. The crawl found no category/division field on the Wix product pages, so everything files under this one label.
